run_note: The operator's folder was named run, copied into the snapshot ahead of the run and identical to the package. GPT-6-astra at effort ultra in Codex CLI, as in run 1; it spawned three subagents, all on gpt-6-astra at ultra. This run is a new session that got the fixed message once and nothing else. Same machine size as the other multi-agent runs (20 vCPUs, 15.6 GiB).
